_about: The blocker round's rules 1 (cert_twin) and 2 (left_keep) as pair rows in kb/exhibit_repoint.py's shape, keyed by (MAP exhibit id + local title). A dry run: nothing is applied. The reviewed apply takes the repoint and confirm rows later (python3 kb/_cred_rename_apply.py --pairs kb/exhibit_blocker_rules_list.json); tap_only rows wait on Sam's tap and are never applied; person and skip rows stay with Sam, listed so the pile stays visible. `rollback` is the apply's undo computed now on copies: every value it would change, before and after.
source: issue #3480, Sources 19 and 21 to 24 (COBIx, 2026-11-17); scope kb/exhibit_blocker_scope.json

A Rule 10 plan, not applied: a fresh live read first; INSERT only, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, under the cohort reviewer_email; rollback deletes the cohort's rows (a keep with no earlier Move or Remove changes nothing in kb/unified_titles.json, so the repo side has nothing to undo).
